reference_kind: AI-authored synthetic development reference frozen before matcher; not teacher gold
scope: Page-local literal labelled declaration blocks, physical session/project identity, separate abstention challenges. No SEP alignment, PDF/OCR evaluation, or production activation.

definitions.denominators: Fixed authored opportunities, separately aggregated; negative documents never enter positive recall.
definitions.literal_detection: Exact type, physical label and complete literal value; no normalization, excerpt or partial-span credit.
definitions.unit_assignment: Combined scope-decision summary only. Positive physical assignment is known_unit_assignment; unresolved_unit_abstentions reports correctly retained null scopes separately. Exact anchor spans reported separately.
definitions.known_unit_assignment: Physical session/project identity under the pre-output v1.1 prefix amendment, over fixed known-unit opportunities only; independent of literal correctness.
definitions.unresolved_unit_abstentions: Explicitly abstained unresolved null scope over fixed unresolved-unit opportunities; never counted as positive physical assignment.
definitions.decisions: Require valid exact literal detection and coherent unit identities/continuation; wrong but self-consistent parent assignments are reported separately.
definitions.unit_errors: ID-to-physical-unit bijection and cross-page continuation errors withhold unit/joint/candidate credit without erasing exact literal detection.
definitions.duplicates: Additional attempts at the same unique overlapping label invalidate the opportunity; unalignable records remain extras.
definitions.extras: output.extras counts every unalignable record; literal_declarations.extras counts their typed-value records. Challenge emissions remain in typed-value precision denominator.
definitions.negative_documents: Exclusive document outcomes: false candidate, invalid/extra emission, explicit abstention, or clean silence.
definitions.source_binding: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON original page strings; extracted-text snapshot, not PDF-byte provenance.

limits: Supplied development reference: see reference_kind and scope; not teacher validation or global reliability.
No SEP catalogue identity, curricular alignment, pedagogical truth or publication authority.
No OCR/PDF extraction, real API calls, cost or latency measured.
